newsitem.title: JAPAN: TIFFE euroyen ends up on falls in US rates, swaps.
newsitem.headline: TIFFE euroyen ends up on falls in US rates, swaps.

text.p: The key March Euroyen contract ended with handsome gains on Friday in sympathy with the steep falls in U.S. interest rates and yen swap rates, traders said.

"The Euroyen had a positive note from the outset due to the overnight falls in the U.S. rate after the weak June employment data and the sharp declines in yen swaps this morning," said a city bank trader. The key March moved in 99.00-99.04 range with massive turnover of 105,508 contracts.
